title: Crooked Goat Brewing
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We opened our brewery and taproom in Sebastopol nearly ten years ago with the idea of not having any flagship beers, never distributing kegs or putting any cans or bottles in stores. As of now we've pretty much held to that promise except we have settled on some core beers that are always on tap, but that was mostly decided by our customers.
